declarations.docstring: An auxiliary result involving the representation associated with subgroup character data.
A subgroup character obtained from a character and an element of the subgroup normalizer.
A linear equivalence between the function submodules associated with a subgroup character and its normalizer transform.
The normalizer linear equivalence sends a function to evaluation after left multiplication by the normalizing element.
The dimension of the representation associated with subgroup character data is the group cardinality divided by the subgroup cardinality.
A finite-dimensional complex representation associated with a subgroup and a character into the complex units.
A representation isomorphism associated with transforming a subgroup character by a normalizing element.
A function belongs to the subgroup-character submodule exactly when left multiplication by a subgroup element scales it by the character value.
A complex-linear endomorphism of group-valued functions associated with finite subgroup character data.
A family of linear maps from all complex-valued functions on the group into the subgroup-character function submodule.
Restricting the map into the subgroup-character function submodule agrees with the associated representation action.
At each group element, the averaging map is the normalized subgroup sum weighted by inverse character values.
The subgroup-character averaging map fixes every function in the associated submodule.
The subgroup-character average of any function belongs to the associated function submodule.
A complex representation of the group on the subgroup-character function submodule.
The representation action evaluates a function after right multiplication of its argument.
Right translation by a group element as a complex-linear map on functions on the group.
Right translation sends a function to its evaluation after right multiplication by the translating element.
The subgroup-character function submodule is stable under every right translation.
A complex submodule of functions on a group associated with a subgroup character.
Including the submodule-valued map into all functions equals subgroup-character averaging after right translation.
The trace of the subgroup-character function representation equals the trace of averaging composed with right translation on the full function space.
